maddeler.e:
نخترط (form VIII)
# نَخْتَرِطُ (naḵtariṭu) /nax.ta.ri.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# نُخْتَرَطُ (nuḵtaraṭu) /nux.ta.ra.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# نَخْتَرِطَ (naḵtariṭa) /nax.ta.ri.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# نُخْتَرَطَ (nuḵtaraṭa) /nux.ta.ra.tˤ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
